guidelines.title: Scholarship Provider Guidelines
guidelines.description: Thank you for your interest in listing your scholarship. To ensure the inclusion of your scholarship on our platform, please ensure that it adheres to the following guidelines:

guidelines.1: You need to subscribe to a package to be able to submit scholarships and use the AI support services of our platform.
guidelines.2: Students should not be prompted to provide their social security number during the application process.
guidelines.3: Students must not be prompted to provide credit card information during the application process.
guidelines.4: The scholarship must be associated with a legitimate.
guidelines.5: The scholarship should offer a reasonable award, commensurate with the amount of effort required from applicants.
guidelines.6: The scholarship rules must be clearly displayed, outlining all eligibility criteria, deadlines, required materials, and the process for selecting scholarship winners or judging criteria.
guidelines.7: The scholarship listing must not be a duplicate of any scholarships already listed. Please retain all information received from system upon successful completion of the listing process.
guidelines.8: Contact information, including address, phone number, and email, must be easily accessible to students for any inquiries regarding the scholarship and its rules.
guidelines.9: The scholarship provider should provide us with a contact email address that uses the organization's domain name (e.g., admin@examplescholarship.org). It is the responsibility of the scholarship provider to ensure that they can be reached by us.

requiredInformation.title: Required Information to Submit a Scholarship
requiredInformation.scholarshipProviderInformationDescriptio: In order for your scholarship to be listed, we require the mailing address, phone number, contact name, email address, and website URL of your organization. Please note that this information will be used exclusively for internal purposes, although specific fields on the online submission form are mandatory.
requiredInformation.scholarshipInformationDescription: To best serve our site’s users and providers, all scholarships listed must:

scholarshipInformationList.1: Provide a descriptive summary of the award
scholarshipInformationList.2: Include a scholarship title, deadline date, value of the scholarships and number of awards available
scholarshipInformationList.3: Indicate the type of student the scholarship is targeting and be sure to review and edit all filterable criteria to ensure only those students who will qualify for the scholarship being offered will be presented with the scholarship.

hero.title: How It
hero.description: Discover the simple and detailed process to start your scholarship search journey. From account registration to application submission, we'll guide you through each step.

step1.title: Register Account
step1.description: Creating a free account on the EduMatch platform is the first step in your scholarship search journey. The registration process is simple and quick, taking only a few minutes.
details: Fill in basic information: username, email, password
Verify your email to activate your account
step1.additionalInfo: The account is completely free and does not require a credit card. After registration, you can immediately start creating your profile or searching for suitable scholarships.

step2.title: Create Profile
step2.description: Complete your personal profile with comprehensive information so the system can recommend the most suitable scholarships. Your profile includes personal information, education, skills, achievements, certificates, and study goals. You can use profile data to automatically fill in application forms later, saving time. The more detailed your profile, the higher your chances of finding the right scholarship.
details: Personal information: full name, phone number, citizenship, hometown
Education: education level, GPA, standardized test scores, language certificates
Skills and achievements: skills, awards, extracurricular activities
Study goals: preferred country, university, scholarship type
step2.additionalInfo: Your profile is secure and only used to recommend suitable scholarships. You can update your information at any time. When creating an application, you can import data from your profile to automatically fill in information, saving time and ensuring consistency.

step3.title: Create Application Dossier
step3.description: Create an application dossier with all necessary information and documents. Each application dossier is stored with a unique code and can be used to apply to multiple different scholarships. You can import data from your profile to automatically fill in information, then edit and add specific documents for each scholarship. Each scholarship may require different documents, so prepare carefully.
details: Import data from your profile to automatically fill in information
Upload documents: recommendation letters, personal statements, transcripts, certificates
Save the dossier to use for multiple scholarships
step3.additionalInfo: You can create multiple different application dossiers with different information and documents to match each scholarship's requirements. Each dossier has its own unique code and can be edited at any time before submission. Remember to check deadlines and specific requirements for each scholarship before applying.

step4.title: Submit Application
step4.description: After creating your application dossier, you can submit it to suitable scholarships. From the scholarship detail page, you select your created application dossier and submit it. One dossier can be submitted to multiple different scholarships. The system will automatically create an Application-Scholarship relationship and help you track the application status for each scholarship. You will receive notifications when there are updates to your application status.
details: View scholarship details and check requirements
Choose your created application dossier or create a new one
Track application status in My Activity
step4.additionalInfo: After submission, you will receive a confirmation email and can track your application status in 'My Activity'. One dossier can be submitted to multiple scholarships, saving you time. Be patient while waiting for results and continue searching for other scholarship opportunities in the meantime.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: This privacy policy describes how EduMatch collects, uses, and protects your personal information when using our platform.

content: Personal information: name, email, phone number, date of birth, nationality
Educational information: degrees, GPA, certificates, education history
Application information: information in application dossiers and attached documents
Payment information: processed by Stripe, we do not store credit card information
Usage data: activities on the platform, viewed scholarships, tracked items

sections.title: How We Use Information

Connect applicants with scholarship providers
Process payments and manage subscriptions
Send notifications about new scholarships, application updates
Improve service quality and user experience
